title: install-field-ambassador-sync-notes-aug-2027
content:
Meeting: Field Ambassador weekly sync (standup + cross-customer triage)
Date: 2027-08-02
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Benji, Liang, Marta, Ethan, Eleanor (Solutions Eng), Samir (Support)
Duration: 50m

Purpose: catch up on active installs in the ambassador program, highlight emergent customer blockers, coordinate escalations and staffing for next-week site visits. This doc is intentionally lightweight — quick notes, owners, and action items.

1) Quick round-robin status (30m)
- Customer: Meridian Health (onprem) — Benji
  - Current state: Node provisioning complete; failed artifact pull on node-3 due to intermittent proxy auth errors. CI job retries but final image is corrupted on node-3.
  - Blocker: proxy auth intermittency + corrupted image artifact.
  - Mitigation attempted: re-seeded node-3 from node-1 snapshot; still hit image checksum mismatch during container start.
  - Next action: Benji to capture full docker pull trace and proxy logs (JIRA-2413). If artifact mismatch persists, push a fresh build tagged ambassador-hotfix-2027-08-02. Owner: Benji. ETA: 2027-08-03 EOD.

- Customer: Harbor Analytics (VPC) — Liang
  - Current state: control-plane connected; KV-cache warm-up slower than expected causing first-hour latency spikes on longer prompts.
  - Blocker: observed 3x token-latency on sequences >2k tokens. Could be cache warm-up pattern + batch sizing.
  - Experiments: lowered batching window from 12ms to 8ms for one pool; added early-kv-prefetch in config (opt-in).
  - Next action: Liang to run A/B with caching enabled vs kv-prefetch for two days, capture P99 latency before/after. Add telemetry tag in console to track warm-up. Owner: Liang. ETA: 2027-08-05.

- Customer: Arcadia Legal (onprem, air-gapped) — Marta
  - Current state: HSM integration completed; audit logs validated. During policy test they triggered a failover exercise and observed that onboarding automation did not reapply custom iptables rules on failover node.
  - Blocker: custom firewall rules lost during leader election leading to temporary service access break.
  - Root cause hypothesis: post-failover bootstrap hooks run before firewall-apply step due to race in init ordering.
  - Next action: Marta to submit small init-order patch to bootstrapper and run validation in staging. Also raise a docs note for runbook. Owner: Marta. ETA: 2027-08-04.

- Customer: Novum Retail (VPC burst) — Ethan
  - Current state: autoscaler occasionally overshoots target GPUs during sudden traffic bursts (observed twice). This overshoot bricked rate limits on infra provider side leading to degraded throughput for ~15 minutes.
  - Blocker: stabilizing scaling hysteresis and throttle.
  - Mitigation: set temporary cap at pool-level, adjust cooldown to 6m. Need a long-term fix for throttled API error handling and better backoff.
  - Next action: Ethan to prototype a backoff-controller and run controlled traffic test next week. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2027-08-09.

2) Cross-customer themes observed (10m)
- Artifact consistency: two separate installs hit image integrity / artifact mismatch problems this sprint. Action: ask release-engineering for a checksum/manifest probe that nodes run pre-pull. Owner: Aisha -> RE team (linked JIRA-2489).
- Warm-up patterns: multiple VPC customers report initial latency spikes tied to KV cache behavior on large-seq workloads. Engineering to consider early-kv-prefetch as a default opt-in for dedicated capacity pools handling long sequences. Owner: Liang + serving-runtime product PRD.
- Failover ordering: air-gapped/onprem customers with custom networking are sensitive to bootstrap ordering. We should add a short checklist for runbook that explicitly calls out firewall reapply validation during failover drills. Owner: Marta + field-documentation.

3) Escalations and ask list (5m)
- Urgent: Meridian corrupted artifact — escalation to Release Engineering if Benji's investigation shows upstream push corruption. Owner: Aisha.
- Request: Support needs a compact troubleshooting artifact (one-pager) for common install image errors (checksum mismatch, partial pull). Owner: Samir (Support) to draft; deadline 2027-08-06.
- Eng signal: ask infra to add a lightweight preflight that verifies proxy auth and artifact reachability prior to node join. Ticket: JIRA-2497 (Aisha).

4) Field ambassador staffing & travel windows (3m)
- Next site visits: Meridian on-prem window 2027-08-09 — tentative two-person team (Benji + Marta). Confirm travel approvals by 2027-08-04.
- Harbor follow-up remote deep-dive scheduled 2027-08-06 (Liang + Eleanor).

5) Runbook / docs updates (2m)
- Action: add new section to Field Ambassador Runbook: "Artifact integrity troubleshooting" and "Failover firewall checklist". Draft owner: Marta. Target publish: 2027-08-10.

6) Notes-to-self / unresolved questions (freeform)
- Should we add a transient artifact mirror in region for installs that have intermittent egress to reduce corrupted pulls? Pros/cons: increases release complexity but could dramatically reduce install flakiness.
- Are there telemetry gaps in the install agent that prevent us seeing partial pulls (i.e., bytes transferred)? If yes, file a small instrumentation ticket.
- For autoscaler overshoot: do we want policy-level soft caps + provider-level hard caps? Need to coordinate with infra and platform cost owners.

7) Action items recap (owners + ETA)
- Benji: docker pull trace + proxy logs + optional repush if needed (JIRA-2413). ETA 2027-08-03 EOD.
- Liang: run A/B on kv-prefetch, report latency delta. ETA 2027-08-05.
- Marta: bootstrapper init-order patch + runbook updates. ETA 2027-08-04 (patch), 2027-08-10 (runbook).
- Ethan: prototype backoff-controller for autoscaler overshoot. ETA 2027-08-09.
- Samir: draft support one-pager on image errors. ETA 2027-08-06.
- Aisha: raised infra preflight ticket (JIRA-2497) and coordinate with RE on manifest probe (JIRA-2489). ETA 2027-08-03.

Wrap-up: next sync 2027-08-09 morning. If Meridian artifact issue escalates, we will run an emergency call before travel.

Draft notes saved here as working doc — please add inline comments rather than creating separate duplicates.

-- end of notes --
